findings.detail: TS2339: Property 'type' does not exist on type 'GatewayEvent'.

findings.message: Type '"MESSAGE_CREATE"' is not comparable to type 'EventType'. Allowed values: "message.created", "message.updated", "reaction.added".
Type '"MESSAGE_UPDATE"' is not comparable to type 'EventType'. Allowed values: "message.created", "message.updated", "reaction.added".
Type '"REACTION_ADD"' is not comparable to type 'EventType'. Allowed values: "message.created", "message.updated", "reaction.added".
